notes.title: JARPUG KICKSTARTER release and demo!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44270474/1769c163dc31d5909b08352d5813077ef570a23c.png
JARPUG's Kickstarter is live now! I've been working on this little dog JRPG/platformer for years, and this could help make it bigger and better. So tell your friends, tell your dogs, tell your mom.

There's a new demo out for Next Fest that should get you to Pet Hell and give you a taste of SUPERHELL! Tell me what you think!
